trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

1. **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging before it was released to production.
2. **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. I rolled back to it in all three regions. Afterward the service passed health checks with an error rate of about 0.2%. This didn't need change-manager approval, since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
3. **Incident:** INC-0001 is titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0." It records the failure, the rollback and what's still to do: find the root cause and review why a release that failed in staging went to production.
   - My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that nothing had been created, then retried using the same idempotency key, so the on-call engineer was paged only once. There is exactly one incident open.
